//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the SPINNER component — the rotating-border spinner (keen `Loader.spinner/1`, svelte `feedback/Spinner.svelte`). SCOPE: the flat `pa-spinner` block only. This is the SIBLING of the advanced-loader family (loader.json covers pa-loader-{dots,bars,…}); the spinner is a SEPARATE block/component. Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/loaders.html + _loaders.scss.

propsVocabulary.size: spinner size — core ships ONLY --xs (snippets/loaders.html + _loaders.scss document no --sm/--md/--lg/--xl). Both wrappers restrict `size` to xs; any other size renders at the default.
propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant primary|secondary|success|danger|warning|info — emits pa-spinner--{variant}, which sets border-top-color from the $btn-*-bg theme tokens (a REAL class, unlike the advanced loaders which theme via currentColor)
propsVocabulary.class: extra classes appended verbatim (passthrough, not a core feature)

goldenConventions: Structural: the spinner is an empty self-closing-ish <div> with no children (CSS-only, animated via border-top + @keyframes pa-spin). The block class is pa-spinner; size emits pa-spinner--xs; variant emits pa-spinner--{variant}. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-spinner(--)?'). Unlike the advanced loaders, the spinner HAS real colour modifier classes (pa-spinner--{variant}). The only size is --xs.

class.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature
